courses.summary: 以韋帕地區安杜姆鋁土礦為案例，研究淺層礦石、洗選、運輸與復育界面。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A Weipa-region Andoom bauxite case examines shallow ore, washing, transport and rehabilitation interfaces. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
